headline: Rents hit record highs: in the city, prices come close to 1,000 euros for 70 square meters
summary: Rents in Monza and Brianza reached record highs, with third-quarter prices rising 3.9%, well above the national average, and some flats nearing 1,000 euros for 70 square metres.
why: Rental price trends reflect local housing demand and affect residential property returns and household inflation pressures.
